name: night-shift
description: Runs the Night Audit three-way match at 02:00 UTC, then has a read-only investigator look at what is new.
author: Marc-Dvci
highlights: Runs nightaudit for every control in apps/*/controls/ at 02:00 UTC, on the minute
At 02:30 UTC an investigator agent with read-only tools looks at each new finding that exists with no approval (OB and O)
A note reaches the page only if every number in it is in the finding's evidence and it is chained to the run
useCases: A startup CTO who wants the morning report ready before anyone has looked at the bill
An IT manager preparing a quarterly access review that an auditor will test
configuration: Both crons are installed paused. Each job's message is JSON naming your Night Audit checkout: run kirocrew cron update <job-id> --message '{"checkout": "<absolute path>"}' for night-audit and night-notes, then resume them
The checkout needs uv sync done once, and uv on the gateway's PATH
The night-notes job runs Kiro CLI with the checkout's night-investigator agent; resume it after kiro-cli can start that agent
AWS credentials come from the gateway's environment (AWS_PROFILE); give that profile read-only IAM permissions
